stem: One sensor consistently reads 3 °C warmer than two colocated peers. What is the best next step before redesigning the control strategy?
choices: Verify sensor placement, shielding and calibration/verification status
Average the three readings and assume all are valid
Move the plants instead of checking the sensor
rationale: Colocated disagreement is a data-quality signal. Measurement quality should be checked before system-level conclusions are made.
